the Fas/Fas ligand system may be involved in the destruction of acinar and ductular epithelial cells in salivary tissues of patients with primary Sjögren’s syndrome (pSS), and that this system is not related to HTLV‐I infection in pSS.

The main takeaway from our work is that
apoptosis is a type of programmed cell death that is important in normal tissue development and homeostasis.
